newGeometry: Scalene triangle A(−L/2,−H/3), B(L/2,−H/3), C(skew,2H/3). Six internal trisector directions from signed angle/3; paired adjacent trisectors intersect to give Morley pocket; opposite-side intersection gives six ray anchors. Three original vertices plus six anchors =9 through holes. Original 3D CSG stage, removable inset, two two-tongue feet, connected runner carrier. Not an archived Routh pivot-arm kit, tomahawk trisection tool or projection-screen kit.
